method: Exact integer Machin interval and interval-stable continued fractions

finite_global_minimum_certificate.principle: Legendre: abs(x-p/q)<1/(2q^2) for reduced p/q implies a continued-fraction convergent.
finite_global_minimum_certificate.coverage: Every convergent with denominator <= Q checked; first convergent above Q certified.
finite_global_minimum_certificate.conclusion: The last strict record is the unique minimum of q*abs(q*pi-p) among reduced fractions with 1<=q<=Q.

scope: Finite certified convergent scan. It does not prove an infinite subsequence with q*abs(beta) tending to zero.
